title: Emergency Deployment
caption: Emergency Deployment (V)
game_text: ▲ a device or a non-lightsaber weapon. OR If opponent just initiated a battle or Force drain at a system or sector, ▼ (as a ‘react’) an unpiloted TIE and a pilot of ability < 3 (simultaneously). {sense}
lore: TIE fighters are stored in large racks far above the hangar deck. Catapulted into space by powerful tractor beam generators, TIEs can quickly scramble to engage the enemy.

notes: Non-unique (no dot). Text starts with the ▲ triangle. Red circle-slash S at the end of the text → {sense}. Curly single quotes around ‘react’ (closing quote before the parenthesis). Lore matches the scan. Base scan 745 px (Premiere-D-emergencydeployment.gif) carries a 'D-E1' label (Decipher errata printing: text says 'reveal up to 3 cards' where the archive face says 'draw') — top half is the printed face; copyright line legible: 1995. The 350 px printed archive face (Premiere-D-emergencydeployment-decipher-archive.gif, the wiki's base page image) also downloaded to src/vs2/, not used. Modern remake is Block-era only (VB1-D-emergencydeployment-pre.gif, 350 px) — used as modern.
